name: Band Pull Apart
cardText:
Band Pull Apart
Novice
1
Grab the band with a shoulder width grip. Point your arms straight in front of you.
2
Retract your shoulder blades and shoulder joint until the band taps your chest.

name: Band Face Pull
cardText:
Band Face Pull
Novice
1
Anchor the band at eye level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
2
Use an overhand grip with both hands. Pull the band to the bridge of your nose flaring your elbows out.

name: Band High Face Pull
cardText:
Band High Face Pull
Novice
1
Start with a band anchored to a high point. Stagger your stance.
2
Pull the band to the bridge of your nose.

name: Band Rear Delt Fly
cardText:
Band Rear Delt Fly
Intermediate
1
Start by standing between the two anchored bands with your feet shoulder-width apart and the bands positioned at a high point.
2
Grasp the ends of each band with your hands, keeping your palms facing each other.
3
Keeping your arms slightly bent and your back straight, slowly pull the bands away from your body until your arms are extended straight out to the sides. Hold for a second, then slowly release back to the starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Mini Band Bent Over Rear Delt Row
cardText:
Mini Band Bent Over Rear Delt Row
Novice
1
Stand on band, hinge forward with neutral spine.
2
Row elbows out wide, squeezing shoulder blades back.
3
Lower slowly, maintaining bent-over position.

name: Mini Band Clock Tap
cardText:
Mini Band Clock Tap
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, stand tall on one leg.
2
Tap opposite foot forward, side, then back.
3
Maintain balance and hip stability throughout movement.

name: Mini Band External Rotation
cardText:
Mini Band External Rotation
Novice
1
Anchor band, elbow at side bent 90 degrees.
2
Rotate forearm outward, keeping elbow pinned.
3
Return slowly to start, controlling resistance.

name: Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
cardText:
Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
Novice
1
Loop band around wrists, hold high plank.
2
Step one hand outward against band tension.
3
Return and alternate, keeping hips level.

name: Mini Band Pull Apart
cardText:
Mini Band Pull Apart
Novice
1
Hold band at shoulder height, arms straight.
2
Pull hands apart, squeezing shoulder blades together.
3
Return slowly, maintaining tension throughout.
